text:
tam: Quick follow-up on the authz postmortem. Two issues: expired service token reused, and a logging emitter gap that dropped token_validation rows. Need owners, short-term mitigations, and a plan to prevent recurrence.
ryan: I can take the audit+metrics work. Will add a dashboard and an alert for missing token_validation events. ETA Tue EOD.
ops-bot: Incident task created: SEC-2026-1105. Please assign owners.
tam: For secrets rotation verification I want a checklist and a canary run in prod. @ryan can you add a smoke job after any secret change?
ryan: Yes. Smoke job will run: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://auth.redwood.example/v1/validate | jq .ok
``` Will wire it to deploy pipeline.
sec: I'll own rotations and runbook updates. Plan: rotate ingress-proxy key tonight 02:00 UTC, on-call present, and validate logs for token_validation success.
tam: Short mitigation: add a temporary fallback check in the ingress-proxy to reject tokens that haven't been seen in validation logs for >5m. Also add an alert for audit_emitter_down.
ryan: Proposed alert expression: rate(audit_log_miss_total[5m]) > 0.001 by (service) -> page. I'll PR to infra-alerts.
sec: Rotation checklist (brief): 1) generate key, 2) update secret, 3) rolling restart pods, 4) run smoke, 5) verify audit logs. I'll attach checklist to SEC-1105 and mark stages.
tam: Owners & deadlines: ryan - audit/dashboard & alert (due 2026-04-07), sec - rotation + runbook (due 2026-04-06). ops-bot, create subtasks.
ops-bot: Subtasks created: 1105-A audit-dashboard (owner:ryan, due:2026-04-07), 1105-B rotate-and-verify (owner:sec, due:2026-04-06).
ryan: Found 7 missing token_validation entries for ingress-proxy during the window; log emitter had a restart at that time. I'll add a panel showing emitter restarts vs missing rows.
sec: Canary rotation done in staging; smoke passed. Scheduling prod rotation now. Will post runbook link and results when complete.
tam: Good. Make the smoke job weekly as well. We'll reconvene next Wed to close out SEC-1105 or earlier if issues. :thumbsup:
